resources.string: Use a signed-in, unprotected profile for YouTube playback and Spotify audio matching. Requests are associated with that account. Only a revocable reference is saved; cookies are not copied. NewPipe remains anonymous; signed-in playback uses Grayjay.
The linked YouTube account is unavailable. Sign in again in its profile or remove this link.

YouTube requires you to verify your login again. Open the YouTube profile, sign in to the source again and complete any verification on the website, then retry.
